title: Asymptotics of the smallest Krawtchouk zero
statement: Fix $\tau$ with $0 < \tau < 1/2$, and let $(t_n)$ be a sequence of natural numbers with $t_n/n \to \tau$. Then there is a real sequence $(a_n)$ with the following three properties. First, for all sufficiently large $n$, the number $a_n$ lies strictly below every real zero of the Krawtchouk polynomial $K_{t_n}^{(n)}$; that is, $K_{t_n}^{(n)}(\xi) = 0$ implies $a_n < \xi$. Second, $a_n/n \to \tfrac12 - \sqrt{\tau(1-\tau)}$. Third, for all sufficiently large $n$, the truncated Christoffel--Darboux kernel satisfies $\Phi_{n,t_n}(a_n, x) \le 0$ for every integer $x$ with $\big\lfloor (\tfrac12 - \sqrt{\tau(1-\tau)})\,n \big\rfloor \le x \le n$.
